product.title: Luxury Tax in Action — Scenario Simulation
product.summary: A scenario lab where roster moves recompute payroll, tax and wins live.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students pick a scenario whose targets and league rules are locked, then edit only their own roster moves while payroll, progressive and repeater tax, all-in spend and projected wins recompute, with a badge showing whether the scenario's targets are met.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.
